analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read is caused by decode_R13_R2000 trusting a file-controlled header section length/path and calling dwg_decode_header_variables without constraining the Bit_Chain read window to the header section bounds. As a result, FIELD_BD reads (via bit_read_BD -> bit_read_BB) can advance to dat->byte == dat->size and still dereference dat->chain[dat->byte] because CHK_OVERFLOW only rejects dat->byte > dat->size, not ==, leading to 1-byte read past end in bit_read_BB.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In llvmfuzz, attacker-controlled DWG bytes set up header/section metadata so header variable decoding continues up to end of input buffer. During dwg_decode_header_variables (header_variables.spec, e.g. FIELD_3BD/BD sequence around PEXTMAX), a compacted double read invokes bit_read_BD/bit_read_BB at end-of-buffer. Since decode_R13_R2000 does not clamp dat->size to the declared header_vars.size/section end before decoding, and bit_read_BB permits dat->byte==dat->size, the PoV with 205-byte input triggers an out-of-bounds read at bits.c:198.
